description: Reti Geodetiche is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sit.puglia.it. The Regional Geodetic Network established in 2006 consists of: refining network of the IGM95 network. Composed of 365 newly established summits, materialised in accordance with the Technical Specifications "Rental of the Fundamental Network IGM95 IntesaGIS. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic networks" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
